For the best result, use the complete Rug & Pad Set on a hard, flat floor. A low-pile, firm carpet may work, but carpet generally isn’t recommended.

Clear the area before setup.
Lay out the numbered Cushioned Rug Pad pieces and connect the interlocking edges until they lie flat.
Place the rug cover on top and tuck each pad corner into the matching patented corner pocket.
Center the cover, smooth wrinkles from the center outward, then gently pull it taut and apply the included corner grippers.

For care, remove the cover from the pad before washing. Wash it cold on a delicate cycle with mild, non-bleach detergent. Don’t use bleach or fabric softener.
